verses.text: Behold, YHWH is emptying the earth, and is making it waste; and He has twisted its surface and has scattered its dwellers.

verses.text: And it will be—as with the people so with the priest, as with the servant so with his master, as with the maidservant so with her mistress, as with the buyer so with the seller, as with the lender so with the borrower, as with the creditor so with the lender of it.

verses.text: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly plundered, for YHWH has spoken this word.
